channel.description: Security notes from the dark side of the internet

item.title: CVE-2026-21589: Atlassian's Eight-Product Bug, Exploited Within Hours
item.description: A single shared library turned eight Atlassian Data Center products into one giant target — and attackers started probing honeypots the same day the technical write-up dropped.

item.title: Mythos: The AI That Hunts Zero-Days
item.description: Anthropic's secretive Mythos model chained two ordinary-looking bugs into a critical auth bypass — then attackers exploited it within 24 hours of disclosure. This is what machine-speed vulnerability research looks like.

item.title: EASM: Mapping Your Attack Surface Before Attackers Do
item.description: Most organizations aren't breached through the front door, but through assets they didn't even know existed. EASM is the discipline of finding them first.
